fields.name: year_closed
fields.title: Year closed
fields.description: Four-digit year the library permanently closed. When set, Status must be 'Closed (permanent)'.

fields.title: Temporary closure expected reopening

fields.title: Weekly total hours

fields.name: automated_access_system
fields.title: Automated access system
fields.description: Automated access control or self-service system used to support visitors during unstaffed opening hours (e.g. Open+, Lyngsoe, Self-service kiosk)

fields.name: co_located
fields.title: Co-located
fields.description: Whether the library is co-located with other services or organizations in the same building unit

fields.name: co_located_with
fields.title: Co-located with
fields.description: Details of services or facilities co-located with the library. For multiple co-locations, separate values with a semicolon (;), e.g. 'Council customer services; Community centre; Post office'.

fields.name: guest_wifi
fields.title: Guest wifi
fields.description: Whether free guest Wi-Fi is available for public use by visitors (infers free public Wi-Fi)

fields.name: member_wifi
fields.title: Member wifi
fields.description: Whether Wi-Fi is available to registered library members using library card authentication

fields.name: public_computers
fields.title: Public computers
fields.description: Whether the library provides public access computers for visitors

fields.name: printing
fields.title: Printing
fields.description: Whether printing, copying, or scanning facilities are available for public use

fields.name: meeting_rooms
fields.title: Meeting rooms
fields.description: Whether meeting rooms, study rooms, or hireable event spaces are available for public or community use

fields.name: cafe
fields.title: Café
fields.description: Whether an on-site café or public refreshment facility is available

fields.name: quiet_study_space
fields.title: Quiet study space
fields.description: Whether dedicated quiet study areas, study carrels, or desk spaces with power outlets are provided

fields.name: makerspace
fields.title: Makerspace
fields.description: Whether a makerspace or digital fabrication equipment (such as 3D printers or laser cutters) is available

fields.name: step_free_access
fields.title: Step-free access
fields.description: Whether the library entrance and main service areas have step-free / level access for wheelchair users and pushchairs

fields.name: accessible_toilet
fields.title: Accessible toilet
fields.description: Whether an accessible wheelchair-friendly public toilet or Changing Places facility is available on site

fields.name: baby_changing
fields.title: Baby changing
fields.description: Whether baby changing facilities are available

fields.name: changing_places_toilet
fields.title: Changing Places toilet
fields.description: Whether a fully equipped Changing Places accessible toilet is available

fields.name: hearing_loop
fields.title: Hearing loop
fields.description: Whether an induction loop or hearing loop system is installed to support hearing aid users

fields.name: sensory_space
fields.title: Sensory space
fields.description: Whether a dedicated sensory room, sensory space, or designated sensory-friendly hours are provided

fields.name: accessible_parking
fields.title: Accessible parking
fields.description: Whether dedicated accessible or disabled parking bays are available on site or nearby

fields.name: facilities_and_services
fields.title: Facilities and services
fields.description: Semicolon-separated list of all public facilities, amenities, and specialized digital resources available at the library branch (e.g. 'Books; Printing; Free Wi-Fi; Findmypast; British Newspaper Archive; BFI Replay; Meeting rooms')

fields.name: phone_number
fields.title: Phone number
fields.description: Direct public phone number for this specific library branch

fields.name: email_address
fields.title: Email address
fields.description: Direct public email address for this library branch, or the general service email if not available

fields.name: url
fields.title: URL
fields.description: Public web page URL specifically for this library branch

fields.name: catalogue_url
fields.title: Catalogue URL
fields.description: Branch-specific online catalogue URL

fields.name: join_online_url
fields.title: Join online URL
fields.description: Branch-specific online joining URL

fields.name: virtual_tour_url
fields.title: Virtual tour URL
fields.description: 3D or virtual walkthrough tour URL for the library building

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Public notes regarding library services, facilities, or planned changes
